note: Working beef and quarter-horse farm campground on the Upper Iowa River, ~10 min from Decorah. Mowed riverside field sites and cabins; canoe landing and watercraft shuttle. Free farm tours. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15/$30, riverfront as a field; added phone reservations and shower. No amp, site count or season on the operator's pages. Keep: presence and price good.
flags: PRIVATE CHECKS: Google 4.4 / 77 reviews with phone and website, including a 2-years-ago report of $15 a tent and a 3-months-ago stay. RV Life 4.5* / 3 reviews, $$, avg $27, 25 sites (stored rating stars 5 is stale; not written). Working site with phone 563-382-3054. Posted $30 electric, under the $50 gate; gateway none within 40 km (Wisconsin Dells 170 km), not needed. Long-stay tests: nothing seasonal or monthly anywhere on the site. Family has not stayed (no references). GS/Passport/military: nothing stated.

Waterfront: riverfront holds for the field along the river. Esri shows fire rings in open mowed grass close to the top of the Upper Iowa's bank (river roughly 35-45 m wide), no road between, some bank brush. There are NO built pads; it is a mowed pasture with tracks. Electric sites could not be told apart on imagery (fire rings also line the lane about 80-120 m back), so if electric is only along the lane, the $30 sites are riverview at best. Operator says only 'natural riverside campsites'.
Fit: no length statement; open field, so the $15 primitive base stands for a 23-ft rig. inclusion_evidence's 'big-rig-friendly' is RV Life's; the operator doesn't say it.
Also a restroom per the office line and an outhouse per a Google review; flush_toilets not written because the page doesn't say flush. Shower cost $2 per a Google review. Pin in the field: fine.
